walkthroughs.body_html: A correlation coefficient r ranges from -1 to +1. +1 is a perfect positive, -1 is a perfect negative, 0 is no link. Correlations show association, not causation — a third variable might explain the pattern.

A test can be reliable but invalid (consistently measuring the wrong thing). Reliability is checked via test-retest or inter-rater. Validity includes internal (control) and external (generalisability) types.
Use the mean for interval data, the median for skewed data or ordinal scales, and the mode for categories. Pair averages with range or standard deviation to show spread.
